author: Inside Edition
description: Kristi Noem's marriage is under the microscope after she was fired as Homeland Security secretary, following a disastrous appearance before Congress. Noem's husband, Bryon, sat behind her as she was grilled about Corey Lewandowski, her top aide. The Noems have been married for 34 years, and every year on their anniversary, they post their wedding photo. Now, many are wondering if their marriage can survive the crisis.
title: Will Kristi Noem's Marriage Survive After Disastrous Hearing?

author: Inside Edition
description: In a shocking image, a 10-year-old boy was led out of a police car in handcuffs and taken down a walkway. In ankle shackles, he was placed in a holding cell. The sheriff says the student was arrested after making a threat that he would "bring a gun to school." Sheriff Mike Chitwood of Volusia County, Florida posted the video of the perp walk on Instagram without blurring the minors face, a decision that has stirred controversy. Inside Edition spoke to the boy's attorney.
title: Sheriff's Post Of Child's Perp Walk On Instagram Causes Controversy

author: Inside Edition
description: Actress Daryl Hannah lashed out over her unflattering portrayal in "Love Story: John F. Kennedy Jr & Carolyn Bessette.” Hannah has not spoken publicly about her six-year relationship with JFK Jr until now. Hannah wrote an opinion piece in Friday's "New York Times." She says the portrayal of her character in the series "is not even a remotely accurate representation of my life, my conduct or my relationship with John."
title: Actress Daryl Hannah Lashes Out Of Her Portrayal in 'Love Story'

author: Inside Edition
description: Britney Spears' ex-husband is speaking out about the pop star's arrest for driving under the influence. Sam Asghari is calling on everyone to give Spears space. "When it comes to people making mistakes, I understand that, but I think everybody deserves privacy," Asghari said. Police say Spears was speeding dangerously down a freeway for nearly an hour Wednesday night before police pulled her over. Highway patrol said Spears was on both alcohol and drugs.
title: Britney Spears' Ex-Husband Sam Asghari Speaks Out After Her Arrest

author: Inside Edition
description: The CEO of McDonalds posted a video taste testing their new sandwich, but the tiny bite he took quickly went viral. Chris Kempczinski took a bite of the fast food chain's latest burger, The Big Arch. Now, many on social media are mocking his reaction. The CEOs of McDonald's fast food rivals are joining in the fun making their own videos with a lot bigger bites. McDonald's now says the launch of the Big Arch Burger is a big success.
title: CEO Of McDonald's Bit Into Its New Burger And It Went Viral

author: Inside Edition
description: Are drones the future of school defense? A new program called Campus Guardian Angel is using specialized drones to defend against active shooters. Their devices are stored on school campuses and are piloted remotely. They say the drones can be deployed in seconds, fly through hallways at up to 50 mph, and are armed with non-lethal pepper ball rounds to take down a shooter in under a minute. INSIDE EDITION spoke with CEO Justin Marston, who showed us how the state-of-the-art technology works.
title: Can These Tactical Drones Stop A School Shooter In Seconds?

author: Inside Edition
description: A fallen soldier was remembered by another group he was committed to, his martial arts community. Sgt. Noah Tietjens was honored at a studio in Omaha, Nebraska, on what would have been his 43rd birthday. It's where he and his family all achieved black belts and where the grand master says he practiced his craft up until the end. Tietjens was killed in a drone strike on his Army base in Kuwait on March 1. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Martial Arts Community Honors Fallen Soldier Noah Tietjens On His Birthday

author: Inside Edition
description: According to police, the "Toxic" singer refused to get out of her car when she was pulled over on the 101 Freeway in California.
title: Was Britney Spears Trying To Evade Arrest? #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Jeff Beyer credits his quick-thinking grandchildren with saving his life. The 75-year-old Beyer was babysitting 8-year-old Everett and 6-year-old Annemarie. The kids tell Inside Edition that their grandfather was reading them a story when he passed out. They used their grandfather's phone to call 911. It turned out Beyer was suffering a heart attack and needed to be rushed to the hospital. Thankfully his grandkids had been taught by their mom about what to do in an emergency.
title: Hero Grandkids, 8 and 6, Save Grandpa's Life After Heart Attack

title: Rookie Firefighter Rescues Teen From River #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Kristi Noem is out as Homeland Security secretary. Noem has reportedly been on shaky ground for months. Embarrassing blow-ups Wednesday at a hearing on Capitol Hill reportedly pushed President Donald Trump over the edge. Noem was pressed about rumors that she is having an affair with top aide Corey Lewandowski. Noem arrived at the hearing with her husband of 34 years, Byron. He left halfway through and didn’t witness his wife being questioned about Lewandowski.
title: Kristi Noem Fired As Homeland Security Secretary

author: Inside Edition
description: Video captured a bunk bed collapsing on top of a sleeping child. His big sister ran for help and the little one was freed from underneath the mattress. The mother, Aurora Price, said on social media that she assembled the bunk bed herself. She also says she's thankful neither of her kids were hurt. She says the company that sold her the bed apologized in an email saying some of the slats were "shorter than standard" and they will conduct an "internal investigation" to determine what went wrong.
title: Bunk Bed Caught On Camera Collapsing With Kids On It

author: Inside Edition
description: Chhavi Verg, a former Miss New Jersey, shared her video diary with Inside Edition that showed her escape from Dubai. She and her husband were stranded in the United Arab Emirates when missiles began to fall. They found a flight to London that was listed as cancelled online and took the chance it would fly. Verg posted her journey on her Instagram @chhaviverg. One flight that managed to leave Dubai landed in New York City Thursday. Inside Edition spoke with other Americans who managed to leave the Middle East.
title: More US Citizens Manage To Escape Dubai Amid War In Middle East
